verdict.rationale: Render has a dedicated first-party webhooks doc page. It describes workspace-level webhooks that notify other systems when service events occur, such as a deploy starting or a service scaling down, so a programmatic consumer can subscribe to platform events. Missing for 10: a documented event catalog and payload schema, signature verification, retry/delivery guarantees, programmatic webhook registration via API/CLI/MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: You can configure *webhooks* for your Render workspace to notify other systems when specific service events occur (such as a deploy starting or a service scaling down)
